subject: AuroraRx expansion — add'l teams, keys, and term alignment
messages:
From: Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@aurorarx.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion request — add'l service teams + keys

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — AuroraRx is excited about the latency and cost numbers you shared. We're greenlit to expand beyond the initial Patient-Facing portal pilot into two more internal teams: Clinical Research Insights and Billing Automation. High level asks:

- Separate API keys per team (dev/stage/prod) with naming convention; approx 6 new keys.
- Predictable reserved capacity for peak batch jobs (we estimate +250k tokens/day across teams).
- A short SOW or amendment that updates term to cover additional apps and a small uptick to committed usage.

Attaching a simple mapping sheet for teams and owners. Can we get a proposed rollout plan and a timeline for provisioning keys + any pricing delta? Priyanka Mehta (cc'd) will own technical onboarding from our side. Legal is looped for SOW.

Best,
Peter
Peter Sullivan
Director of Platform Integrations
AuroraRx

Attachment: AuroraRx_Mapping_v1.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@aurorarx.com>, Priyanka Mehta <prianka.mehta@aurorarx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add'l service teams + keys

Peter — thanks, and congrats on the decision to expand. Quick take and proposed next steps below.

Summary of what we'll deliver:
- Per-team API credentials (dev/stage/prod) with RBAC-friendly naming.
- Reserved capacity slot to cover expected peak plus 20% buffer; we'll size based on your peak-token/day estimate.
- Amendment / SOW that captures new projects, adjusted committed units, and a short term extension option.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal kick-off (30m) this week to confirm team owners and traffic pattern — please propose windows.
2) We run a lightweight capacity forecast (Ben + Karthik) and return recommended commit and pricing delta within 48 business hours.
3) We provision dev/stage keys for the first team as a canary, then prod keys after successful validation.

I attached a checklist so Legal and your PM can see typical timelines. Ben, can you own the sizing and draft the SOW points? Naomi can own console onboarding and key naming. Karthik — any constraints on provisioning cadence?

Thanks — I can do a kickoff Thu morning PDT or Fri afternoon.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@aurorarx.com>, Priyanka Mehta <prianka.mehta@aurorarx.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add'l service teams + keys

Folks — following up with the sizing and a draft SOW summary (high-level). Key bullets:

Sizing notes (based on 250k tokens/day):
- Recommend Reserved commit: 3.5M tokens/month (this covers burst and buffer across teams).
- If AuroraRx wants strict per-team caps, we can shard pools or use quotas (adds ~5% overhead).

Pricing delta (indicative):
- Incremental reserved commit price ~ $0.0028/token (blended); precise rate after contract amendment.
- Short-term discount if you commit 6 months up front.

Operational plan:
1) Provision dev/stage keys for Clinical Research (canary) within 3 business days of kickoff.
2) 7-day canary validation window (latency + correctness checks).
3) Prod keys and reserved capacity change after sign-off.

Attached a lightweight SOW draft you can share with Legal. It lists milestone dates and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — happy to hop on the call and walk through.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_ARX-draft-v2.pdf
From: Priyanka Mehta <prianka.mehta@aurorarx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Cc: Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@aurorarx.com>, Legal Team <contracts@aurorarx.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add'l service teams + keys

Thanks Ben — this looks good. Couple quick clarifications from AuroraRx tech:

- Teams to onboard in phase 1: Clinical Research Insights (team: research-eng), Billing Automation (team: billing-services). We'll follow with a third internal analytics project in phase 2.
- We want the dev keys to include a header-based usage tag so we can reconcile in our logs. Is that supported?
- Our legal team prefers the SOW as an amendment to the existing master agreement rather than a brand-new SOW. I've asked contracts to prepare suggested language (cc'd).

I've attached an updated mapping sheet with team owners and example traffic windows. Can you confirm the earliest dates for dev key provisioning? We can do validation next week if keys arrive by Mon EOD.

Thanks — Priyanka
Priyanka Mehta
Senior Platform PM, AuroraRx

Attachment: AuroraRx_Mapping_v1.xlsx
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Priyanka Mehta <prianka.mehta@aurorarx.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Peter Sullivan <peter.sullivan@aurorarx.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — add'l service teams + keys

Perfect — thanks all. Quick confirmations and next actions:

- Dev keys for Clinical Research (research-eng) will be provisioned by Mon 17 Aug (Ben/Karthik). We'll include header-based usage tag support and provide sample request headers.
- 7-day canary window begins Tue 18 Aug once you flip traffic to dev endpoints.
- Ben will circulate a marked amendment (amend to master agreement) by EOD Fri with the draft pricing line items and milestone dates for acceptance.
- Naomi will create a console onboarding doc and a recommended naming convention for the six keys (dev/stage/prod x 2 teams).

If Legal provides redlines to the amendment, send to me and I'll coordinate. I booked a 30m kickoff Thu 13:30 PDT — invite sent. If that doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0192
